title: Have a coding agent build an Android TV app in Kotlin, sideload it over ADB, and hill-climb it
description: Give a coding agent such as Claude Code or Codex a written brief, a headless Android toolchain and ADB access to a real TV. It builds a Kotlin app with Jetpack Compose for TV, installs it over the network, reads the screen to check its own work, and then improves one measured number in a loop.

lessons.title: Have a coding agent build an Android TV app in Kotlin, sideload it over ADB, and hill-climb it
Write the brief, and steer the agent with a file
Give the agent a toolchain it can run headless
Turn on network debugging and connect with ADB
Scaffold a Compose for TV app in Kotlin
The agent's loop: build, install, launch, read the screen
Measure a number on the real TV
Example run: what the agent built and what went wrong
Optional: if your app talks to a server, Tailscale and pairing over ADB
